subject.title: Feature request: Auto-send intent/acknowledgment text message before agent processing

question: Should OpenClaw solve pre-processing text acknowledgements as a global messages.ackText config, a generic send-and-continue plugin/channel lifecycle hook, or only channel-specific placeholder features?
rationale: The gap is source-proven, but the durable answer affects core config surface, plugin API shape, and per-channel UX contracts.

options.title: Define a generic acknowledgement hook
options.body: Add a default-off send-and-continue lifecycle contract first, then expose configuration where the contract proves it belongs.

options.title: Add global messages.ackText
options.body: Implement the requested global config shape directly, accepting a new core config surface that channels must interpret consistently.

options.title: Keep placeholders channel-specific
options.body: Let individual channel plugins implement visible placeholders independently without a cross-channel core contract.

recommendation.title: Define a generic acknowledgement hook
recommendation.body: Add a default-off send-and-continue lifecycle contract first, then expose configuration where the contract proves it belongs.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest recent history across dispatch, source reply delivery, ack reactions, and messaging-channel lifecycle cleanup.
